Annie|mid.identity: Magic damage burst mage, simple and deadly. Every four abilities, her next ability stuns (passive Pyromania). Disintegrate (Q) hits a target (mana refunded if it kills), Incinerate (W) burns in a cone, Molten Shield (E) gives a shield and speed to an ally or herself, and Summon: Tibbers (R) drops the bear in an area, then lets it fight.
Annie|mid.playstyle: Short-range burst and engage mage. Annie wins by keeping her stun ready: it turns every combo into a potential kill.
Annie|mid.early_game: Last hit with Q (mana refunded) and build your passive on minions. Keep your stun ready (the counter is visible) to punish an opponent who steps up. E protects you from poke.
Annie|mid.level_1: Disintegrate (Q) first. Last hit to get your mana back.
Annie|mid.level_2: Incinerate (W). Q + W with your stun ready: a big trade.
Annie|mid.level_3: Molten Shield (E). It adds a passive stack without fighting: use it to prepare your stun before engaging.
Annie|mid.level_6: Summon: Tibbers: full combo with your stun ready: R (area stun) → W → Q, then Tibbers keeps hitting. With Flash, it's one of the most dangerous engages in the game.
power_spikes: Level 3: Q + W burst with a stun.
First completed item: one-shots possible on carries.
Annie|mid.lane_plan: Farm with Q, build your passive and keep your stun ready. Push your wave before roaming. Avoid long-range mages' poke by staying behind your minions. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you roam after pushing.
Annie|mid.trading: Short trade: Q with your stun ready. Full trade: Q (stun) → W → attacks. All-in: Flash → R (stun) → W → Q. Engage when your stun is ready; give up on it if your opponent pokes you from out of range.
threats: Long-range mages who poke you (Syndra, Viktor).
mistakes: Standing in range of enemy poke for no reason.

matchup_notes.Ahri: Stun her before she charms you, especially if she gets close.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: His Wind Wall doesn't block your stun (targeted abilities): punish him when he steps up.
matchup_notes.Syndra: She pokes you: stay behind your minions and engage when her stun is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Zed: Keep your stun for his engage.
matchup_notes.Katarina: Stun her when she lands on her dagger.

Annie|mid.mid_game: Picks and engages with Tibbers around objectives. Roam after pushing.
Annie|mid.late_game: Flash → Tibbers on several enemies with your stun ready. Protect yourself with E.
Annie|mid.ahead: Roam, create picks and engage teamfights.
Annie|mid.behind: Farm, keep your stun and play for a decisive engage.
Annie|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to engage with your stun ready and kill carries in one combo.
Annie|mid.final_tip: Always watch your passive counter: never engage without your stun ready.
